|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E4, the current text (version 5 of 5): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List, official text as of 27 April 2013. It repeats word for word the text of [[Death Star Gunner (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, 17 June 2010). It is the last publication of this card, so it is current; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image here is the Master List slip.
* '''Original''' ([[Death Star Gunner (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009), slip 08: “While on Death Star: cancels opponent's game text on your non-docking bay Death Star sites, your [A New Hope] Epic Event total is cumulatively +2, and, during your deploy phase, may place this character in Used Pile to ▲ Superlaser.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 2, slip 08. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref> Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-08-Death_Star_Gunner.png]]) prints slip number “08” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Death Star Gunner (V) (Errata)]]): The Players Committee news post "Errata to Death Star Gunner (V)/Rebel Tech (V)" (17 June 2010, “Effective immediately”) gave the new text in full (errata slip 1•08E): “While on Death Star: cancels Force drain bonuses from Death Star sites' game text, your [A New Hope] Epic Event total is cumulatively +2, and during your deploy phase, may place this character in Used Pile to ▲ Superlaser.”<ref name="src-S2">Players Committee news post "Errata to Death Star Gunner (V)/Rebel Tech (V)" (Rogue4), 17 June 2010. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100714025220/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=102:errata-to-death-star-gunner-vrebel-tech-v&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]</ref> The Advanced Rulebook 2.0, Appendix A (Errata) (by 27 August 2012) has the same text.<ref name="ar20">[[Media:AR-version-2-0-final.pdf|Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]], Appendix A (Errata), p. A-5; PDF created by 27 August 2012 (announcement date not found). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2013/04/ar_version-2-0_final.pdf</ref>
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Death Star Gunner (V) (Errata 2)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) wrote the ▲ out as “take a Superlaser into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, adding the article “a” (tooltip dated “Errata Text - June 18th, 2010”): “While on Death Star: cancels Force drain bonuses from Death Star sites' game text, your [A New Hope] Epic Event total is cumulatively +2, and during your deploy phase, may place this character in Used Pile to take a Superlaser into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”<ref name="cl-1210_8-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Death Star Gunner (V) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-D-deathstargunner-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)<ref name="pcimg-Virtual1-Dark">Players Committee card image, file <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/deathstargunner.gif</code>; the directory listing of this folder (Virtual1-Dark) was not captured; the captured Legacy folders (Virtual2, Virtual4, Virtual5, Virtual6, Virtual7) all carry 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34, the date the PC rebuilt its image set (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock1-Dark/large/deathstargunner.gif</ref>: “While on Death Star: cancels Force drain bonuses from Death Star sites' game text, your [A New Hope] Epic Event total is cumulatively +2, and during your deploy phase, may place this character in Used Pile to ▲ Superlaser.” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the PC-E1 errata text of 17 June 2010 again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E2) had published a different text. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 1 set mark) and prints the number “08” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E4''' (this page): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side p. 7), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=7, page 7. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=7 Internet Archive]</ref>: “While on Death Star: cancels Force drain bonuses from Death Star sites' game text, your [A New Hope] Epic Event total is cumulatively +2, and during your deploy phase, may place this character in Used Pile to ▲ Superlaser.” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the PC-E1 errata text of 17 June 2010 again, word for word (with ▲). It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image on its page is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1210-8-master.png]]). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number; it prints the errata mark “E” bottom right.
